work.name: HolyPoly GmbH
work.summary: Responsible for all aspects IT: strategy, infrastructure, services, software development,  operations and security.
highlights: Build-up and leading a 5-member IT team plus freelancers on various projects to enhance team capabilities and project delivery.
Introduced agile development methodologies and established automated CI/CD pipelines with trunk-based development, reducing cycle time by a factor of 2.

Designed and implemented software architecture for reverse logistics programs focused on recycling plastic toys for multinational toy and baby product companies, integrating with the corporate website via a REST API.
Developed a Bluetooth-WebSocket bridge service for a handheld proprietary X-ray fluorescence device,  inorganic impurities in recycled plastic toys and power tool housings.
Collected millions of data points, empowering corporate clients to make data-driven decisions on recycled plastic usage in new products.
Implemented open-source ERP software (ERPNext), adapting it for cloud-native patterns to enable quick deployment of instances, streamlining business processes and reducing application fragmentation.

Redesigned monitoring, alerting, and logging stack using Telegraf, Loki, InfluxDB, Alertmanager, and Grafana.
